text: 记忆管理是面向 DSH Web 客户端的工作区记忆插件，在 Host 注册保存、读取、搜索和删除工具，并提供设置面板。记忆以 Markdown 文件保存在当前会话工作目录下，默认使用 ./memory/，MEMORY.md 索引会按磁盘内容生成。可按分类整理记忆、检索标题标签和正文，也能配置索引文件名、条目大小上限与搜索结果数。适合希望跨会话保留项目约定或偏好的用户；无需额外密钥或外部服务。

A DSH web plugin for workspace notes. Tools save, recall, search, and delete Markdown files under the session directory (./memory/ by default), with a regenerated MEMORY.md index. Entries can be categorized and searched by title, tag, or content. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 记住每个项目的约定和偏好，换会话后还能查到。
有没有办法把常用信息存成工作区里的 Markdown 记忆，再按关键词找回来？
I want to keep project notes with the workspace and search them across sessions.
记忆管理的「保存工作区记忆」功能：通过 memory_save 写入带标题、正文、标签和可选分类的 Markdown 条目；同名条目默认报错，显式允许后才覆盖，并可自动重建索引。
记忆管理的「回忆与搜索」功能：memory_recall 可返回索引或读取指定条目，memory_search 可按不区分大小写的文本搜索标题、标签和正文，并返回命中摘录。

给智能体一个**跟着工作区走**的记忆库。

`MEMORY.md` 索引；需要分类的按需建子目录，不需要分类的直接写在根目录。

记忆管理 README · 为什么是「跟着工作区走」：记忆的根目录是**相对于会话的工作目录**（`exec.agent.session.header.cwd`）算出来的，
所以：

- 在 A 项目里记的东西，在 B 项目里**看不到** —— 不会串味；
- 记忆跟着代码走，可以直接提交进版本库（如果你愿意），换台机器 clone 下来还在；
- 想集中存也行，把 `root` 填成 `notes/mem` 之类即可（仍相对工作目录）。

这和「全局记忆」是两种取向：全局记忆省事但容易把项目细节混在一起，
工作区记忆多花一点空间但边界清楚。这个插件选了后者。

text:
记忆管理 README · 四个工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_save` | 存一条记忆。给 `title` + `content`；`category` 可选（`项目约定` 或 `people/work`，最多 3 级）—— **省略即直接写在根目录**。同名默认报错而不是静默覆盖，要覆盖得显式传 `overwrite: true`。 |
| `memory_recall` | 不带参数 → 返回索引（先看它）；带 `name` → 读某一条。`name` 可以是相对路径（`项目约定/提交信息用中文.md`），也可以是唯一后缀（`提交信息用中文`）；匹配到多条会报错并列出候选，**不猜**。 |
| `memory_search` | 跨全部记忆做全文检索（标题、标签、正文，大小写不敏感），返回匹配路径与命中处的摘录。记得有这件事但忘了在哪时用它。 |
| `memory_forget` | 删一条记忆。只接受单个 `.md` 文件，**永远不会删目录**，也不会碰 `./memory/` 之外的任何东西。 |

记忆管理 README · 安装：**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入：

```
https://github.com/OraSkyC/dsh-bundle-memory
```

或命令行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/OraSkyC/dsh-bundle-memory
```

装完**重启 DSH**。

记忆管理 README · 设置：**设置 → 插件 → 记忆管理**。改动**立即生效，不用重启**。

配置分两层：`cordis.patch.yml` 写部署默认值（改完需重启），
用户覆盖落到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\state\dsh-bundle-memory\settings.json` 的**稀疏覆盖层**，
点「恢复默认」是删除那个键、回落部署默认值。

记忆管理 README · 设置：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后不注册任何记忆工具，面板仍可打开。 |
| `root` | `memory` | 记忆根目录，相对于会话工作目录，最多 3 级。 |
| `indexFile` | `MEMORY.md` | 索引文件名，位于记忆根目录下。 |
| `autoIndex` | `true` | 每次保存/删除后自动重建索引。 |
| `maxEntryBytes` | `262144` | 单条记忆正文上限（1024–4194304 字节），防止一次把大文件塞进一条记忆。 |
| `searchMaxResults` | `20` | `memory_search` 默认返回条数（1–100）。 |

记忆管理 README · 索引是「投影」，不是「账本」：`MEMORY.md` 每次都由磁盘上的记忆文件**重新生成**（扫描目录 → 读每个文件的 front matter →
按分类分组渲染）。因此不存在「索引和实际内容不一致」这种状态 —— 那是最容易腐坏的东西。

代价是：**手工往 `MEMORY.md` 里加的内容会在下次重建时消失**。文件头写明了这点。
想加记忆就放一个 `.md` 文件进目录（插件会把它纳入索引），或者用 `memory_save`。

记忆管理 README · 每条记忆的格式：```markdown
---
title: 用户偏好用 pnpm
tags: 工具链, 偏好
created: 2026-10-08T08:31:24.000Z

刻意**不引入 YAML 解析器**：格式只有 `key: value` 行，手写解析更可预测，
而且遇到用户手改坏的行只会忽略、不会抛错。没有 front matter 的文件也照收，
标题回落到文件名。

记忆管理 README · 写入路径的防护：这是整个插件最需要小心的地方 —— 智能体给的 `name` / `category` 最终会变成文件路径。
一共四层：

1. **片段校验**（`safeSegment`）：拒绝 `..`、`.`、绝对路径、路径分隔符、
   Windows 非法字符（`\ / : * ? " < > |`）、控制字符、系统保留名（`CON`/`NUL`/`COM1`…）、
   以点或空格结尾、超过 64 字符。
2. **层级限制**：`category` 与 `root` 最多 3 级。
3. **拼完再验一次**（`resolveInside`）：用 `relative()` 检查结果是否仍在记忆根目录内，
   以 `..` 开头就拒绝。即使前面被绕过，这一层也会挡住。
4. **删除只接受 `.md` 文件**：`memory_forget` 永远删不掉目录，也删不掉索引本身。

四层都有测试覆盖，包括各种嵌套 `..` 的穿越尝试。

记忆管理 README · 「当前工作目录」从哪来：```js
const cwd = exec.agent.session.header.cwd ?? process.cwd();
```

工具的第二个参数 `exec` 里带着 agent，agent 带着 session，session 的 header 里有 `cwd`。
**不能用 `process.cwd()`** —— 那是 DSH 自己的安装目录，不是你的工作区。

记忆管理 README · 要求：| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `web` 或任何带 Host `tools` 服务的 profile |
| Node | `>= 22.19.0` |
| npm 依赖 | **无**（只用 `node:` 内建模块） |
| 构建步骤 | **无** |

插件依赖 Host 的 `tools` 与 `webServer` 两个服务
（`inject = ['tools', 'webServer']`）。`webServer` 是**硬依赖**：
Cordis 的 `ctx` 是受限代理，读一个没声明在 `inject` 里的属性会**抛错**而不是返回 `undefined`，
漏声明会让整个 `apply()` 失败、插件在插件页显示「异常」。

记忆管理 README · 常见问题：**记忆会进版本库吗**
`./memory/` 就在工作目录里，取决于你的 `.gitignore`。想让它跟着代码走就别忽略；
不想就加一行 `memory/`。

**为什么智能体不自己想起来用**
这个版本**没有**把索引自动注入上下文 —— 智能体需要主动调 `memory_recall` 或
`memory_search`。建议在项目的 `AGENTS.md` 里写一句「开工前先 `memory_recall` 看索引」。
自动注入是可行的后续方向，但需要构造会话消息并插进消息流，风险更高，单独做。

**索引被我不小心改坏了**
删掉 `memory/MEMORY.md`，下次任何一次保存/删除都会重建它；或者直接调一次
`memory_recall`（不带参数）触发重建。

**能不能存二进制 / 附件**
不能。这是纯 Markdown 记忆库，只认 `.md`。别的东西放工作区别的地方。

记忆管理 README · 目录结构：```
dsh-bundle-memory/
├── package.json         # 清单：dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client / files
├── cordis.patch.yml     # 注册 entry（id: memory）+ 部署默认配置
├── lib/index.js         # 配置契约、路径安全、索引生成、四个工具、面板路由

记忆管理 README · 开发：```bash
npm run check     # 语法检查
npm test          # 宿主 59 项 + 客户端 24 项断言组
```

宿主测试用真实临时目录，覆盖配置归一化、四层路径防护、front matter 往返、
索引生成、四个工具的全部行为、工作区隔离、面板路由。
客户端测试覆盖注册路径、组件渲染，以及两条「界面不会报错」的回归：
**字段标签必须可见**、**用到的 CSS 变量必须真实存在**。

记忆管理 README · Memory · dsh-bundle-memory：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/OraSkyC/dsh-bundle-memory) (DSH) plugin that gives the agent
a memory store **that travels with each workspace**.

Once enabled, memories live under **`./memory/` in the current working directory**, with an
auto-maintained `MEMORY.md` index at its root. Anything that needs classifying goes into a
subdirectory created on demand; anything that does not goes straight into the root.

> English · [简体中文](README.md)

---

记忆管理 README · What it looks like：```
<your working directory>/
└── memory/                       ← memory root (configurable)
    ├── MEMORY.md                 ← index, generated by the plugin
    ├── 用户偏好用-pnpm.md          ← no classification needed: straight into the root

`memory_recall` with no arguments returns the index:

```markdown

记忆管理 README · 记忆索引：> 本文件由 dsh-bundle-memory 自动生成，手工改动会在下次保存记忆时被覆盖。

- 工作区：`D:\OraSkyC\Project\Python`
- 记忆根目录：`D:\OraSkyC\Project\Python\memory`
- 共 3 条记忆

记忆管理 README · 未分类：- [用户偏好用 pnpm](./用户偏好用-pnpm.md) — 工具链, 偏好 · 2026-10-08 · 420 B
- [部署注意事项](./部署注意事项.md) · 2026-10-08 · 1.1 KB

记忆管理 README · 项目约定/：- [提交信息用中文](./项目约定/提交信息用中文.md) — 约定 · 2026-10-08 · 380 B
```

记忆管理 README · Why "per workspace"：The memory root is resolved **relative to the session's working directory**
(`exec.agent.session.header.cwd`), which means:

- what you record in project A is **invisible** in project B — no cross-contamination;
- memories travel with the code, so you can commit them if you want and find them again after a
  clone on another machine;
- you can still centralise them by setting `root` to something like `notes/mem` (still relative to
  the working directory).

记忆管理 README · Why "per workspace"：This is a deliberate trade-off against "global memory": global is less work but mixes project
details together; per-workspace costs a little disk and keeps the boundary clear.

记忆管理 README · Four tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_save` | Store a memory. Takes `title` + `content`; `category` is optional (`项目约定` or `people/work`, at most 3 levels) — **omit it and the file lands in the memory root**. Saving the same title again errors instead of silently overwriting; pass `overwrite: true` to replace. |
| `memory_recall` | No arguments → the index (look here first). With `name` → one memory. `name` may be a relative path (`项目约定/提交信息用中文.md`) or a unique suffix (`提交信息用中文`); more than one match errors and lists the candidates — it **never guesses**. |
| `memory_search` | Full-text search across every memory (title, tags, body; case-insensitive), returning matching paths with an excerpt around the hit. Use it when you remember the thing but not where it lives. |
| `memory_forget` | Delete one memory. Accepts a single `.md` file only — it **never deletes a directory**, and never touches anything outside `./memory/`. |

记忆管理 README · Installation：**Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter:

```
https://github.com/OraSkyC/dsh-bundle-memory
```

Or on the command line:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/OraSkyC/dsh-bundle-memory
```

**Restart DSH** afterwards.

记忆管理 README · Settings：**Settings → Plugins → Memory.** Changes take effect **immediately, with no restart**.

Two layers: `cordis.patch.yml` holds the deploy defaults (restart required), and user overrides land
in the **sparse** override layer at `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\state\dsh-bundle-memory\settings.json`.
"Reset" deletes the key so the field falls through to the deploy default again.

记忆管理 README · Settings：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | When off, no memory tools are registered; the panel still opens. |
| `root` | `memory` | Memory root, relative to the session working directory, at most 3 levels. |
| `indexFile` | `MEMORY.md` | Index file name inside the memory root. |
| `autoIndex` | `true` | Rebuild the index after every save/delete. |
| `maxEntryBytes` | `262144` | Max body size per memory (1024–4194304 bytes), so one call cannot dump a huge file into a single memory. |
| `searchMaxResults` | `20` | Default result count for `memory_search` (1–100). |

记忆管理 README · The index is a projection, not a ledger：`MEMORY.md` is **regenerated** every time from the files on disk (scan the directory → read each
file's front matter → render grouped by category). That is why there is no such state as "the index
disagrees with the content" — the thing most likely to rot.

The cost: **anything you hand-write into `MEMORY.md` disappears on the next rebuild.** The file
header says so. To add a memory, drop a `.md` file into the directory (the plugin will index it) or
use `memory_save`.
section: The index is a projection, not a ledger

text:
记忆管理 README · The shape of one memory：```markdown
---
title: 用户偏好用 pnpm
tags: 工具链, 偏好
created: 2026-10-08T08:31:24.000Z

There is deliberately **no YAML parser**: the format is only `key: value` lines, so a hand-written
parser is more predictable — and a line you break by hand is ignored rather than fatal. Files with
no front matter are still indexed, with the title falling back to the file name.

记忆管理 README · Path safety：This is where the plugin has to be most careful: the `name` / `category` the agent supplies end up
as filesystem paths. Four layers:

记忆管理 README · Path safety：1. **Segment validation** (`safeSegment`): rejects `..`, `.`, absolute paths, path separators,
   Windows-illegal characters (`\ / : * ? " < > |`), control characters, reserved device names
   (`CON`/`NUL`/`COM1`…), trailing dot or space, and anything over 64 characters.
2. **Depth limits**: `category` and `root` are capped at 3 levels.
3. **Re-check after joining** (`resolveInside`): `relative()` must not start with `..`. Even if an
   earlier layer were bypassed, this one still refuses.
4. **Deletes accept `.md` files only**: `memory_forget` can never remove a directory, nor the index.
记忆管理 README · Path safety：All four are covered by tests, including nested `..` traversal attempts.

记忆管理 README · Where "the current working directory" comes from：```js
const cwd = exec.agent.session.header.cwd ?? process.cwd();
```

A tool's second argument `exec` carries the agent, the agent carries the session, and the session
header carries `cwd`. **`process.cwd()` must not be used as the source** — that is DSH's own
installation directory, not your workspace.
section: Where "the current working directory" comes from

text:
记忆管理 README · Requirements：| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | a `web` or any profile whose Host provides the `tools` service |
| Node | `>= 22.19.0` |
| npm dependencies | **none** (only `node:` builtins) |
| Build step | **none** |

记忆管理 README · Requirements：The plugin depends on the Host's `tools` and `webServer` services
(`inject = ['tools', 'webServer']`). `webServer` is a **hard** dependency: Cordis's `ctx` is a
restricted proxy, so reading an undeclared property **throws** rather than returning `undefined`,
and missing it fails the whole `apply()` — the plugin then shows as "error" in the Plugins page.

记忆管理 README · FAQ：**Will memories end up in my repository?**
`./memory/` sits inside the working directory, so it depends on your `.gitignore`. Leave it
un-ignored if you want memories to travel with the code; add a `memory/` line if you do not.

记忆管理 README · FAQ：**Why does the agent not remember by itself?**
This version does **not** inject the index into the context — the agent has to call `memory_recall`
or `memory_search`. A good habit is one line in the project's `AGENTS.md`: "run `memory_recall`
first to read the index". Auto-injection is a viable follow-up, but it means constructing session
messages and splicing them into the message stream, which carries more risk, so it is a separate
piece of work.

记忆管理 README · FAQ：**I broke the index**
Delete `memory/MEMORY.md`; the next save or delete rebuilds it. Or just call `memory_recall` with no
arguments to force a rebuild.

**Can it store binaries or attachments?**
No. This is a plain-Markdown memory store; it only recognises `.md`. Put other things elsewhere in
the workspace.

记忆管理 README · Layout：```
dsh-bundle-memory/
├── package.json         # manifest: dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client / files
├── cordis.patch.yml     # registers the entry (id: memory) + deploy defaults
├── lib/index.js         # config contract, path safety, index generation, four tools, panel routes

记忆管理 README · Development：```bash
npm run check     # syntax check
npm test          # 59 host + 24 client assertion groups
```

记忆管理 README · Development：The host tests use real temporary directories and cover config normalisation, all four path-safety
layers, front-matter round-trips, index generation, every behaviour of the four tools, workspace
isolation and the panel routes. The client tests cover the registration path and component
rendering, plus two regressions that fail **silently** in a browser: **are the field labels
visible**, and **do the CSS variables actually exist**.
记忆管理 README · License：[MIT](./LICENSE)
